props.title: Will mass protests against the war with Ukraine take place in Russia in 2025?
props.shortTitle: Will Russians protest the war in 2025?
props.details:
In September 2024, the Russian research organization Levada Center conducted an opinion poll of Russians' support for the war against Ukraine. According to the study, the number of Russians who believe that the war has brought Russia more harm than good has increased significantly. This was the opinion of 47 percent of respondents, while only 28 percent believed the opposite.

Resolution

A mass protest is considered to be one in which more than ten thousand people participate in one city. The estimate of the number of participants will be made by credible news sources.
